sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 3788 of 2016
Revisionist :- Momraj

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- R.P.S. Chauhan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
2. No one appears on behalf of the revisionist to press this revision.
Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned State counsel is present, who has been heard.

3. The present revision has been filed by the revisionist Momraj against the impugned order dated 01.07.2008 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Bulandshahr in Case No. 1560 of 1994 under Section 7(1), 16(1) (A)(1) the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act convicting and sentencing the revisionist to undergo one year R.I. and fine of Rs. 2,000/- and against the judgment and order dated 05.10.2016 passed by learned Additional Session Judge Court No.1, Bulandshahr in Criminal Appeal No. 34 of 2008 (Momraj Vs. State) awarding six months R.I.
and fine of Rs. 2,000/- to the revisionist.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Bulandshahr
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Momraj vs State Of U.P. on 30 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44528570/
1 4.

As per office report dated 29.11.2023 a report from C.J.M. concerned has been received in compliance of the order dated 30.10.2023, non bailable warrant could not be executed as the revisionist has died.
In compliance of the said order, C.J.M. concerned vide letter dated 07.11.2023 informed that the revisionist - Momraj has died.
The said report has been sent after due enquiry.
5. In view of the same, the revision stands abated.
6. The trial court records, if received, be sent back along with the communication of this order.
Office to communicate this order to the District and Sessions Judge concerned within two weeks from today.

Order Date :- 30.11.2023 M. ARIF (Samit Gopal, J.)
